messages:
Nora V: Postmortem follow-up: pattern recap shows two recurring issues: (1) routing flip when regional storage latency spikes, (2) duplicate snapshot manifests from retry storms. We need crisp owners and a short DR checklist.
Ethan M: Agreed. Break into: routing policy tolerance, snapshot idempotency, cache-warm preflight, and rehearsal cadence.
Sam K: I'll own snapshot idempotency and replication tests. Plan: restore full backup to isolated infra and run with 150ms netem to measure RTO/RPO. ETA Thu.
Nora V: Who can take routing tolerance + canary? Need terraform diff + staged rollout.
Ethan M: I can. Proposal: soft-shift 15% -> monitor 15m -> 60% -> full. Add a reject condition if error-rate >1.5% or KV hit<70%.
Sam K: Add preflight to verify snapshot checksums and that writes are idempotent. I'll add a small validation harness.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2024-09-02 09:00 UTC "DR rehearsal preflight"
ops-bot: Reminder created and added to #incidents calendar.
Nora V: Cache-warm preflight — owner? We saw cold-KV storms when failover happened. Must prime top keys and verify hit rate.
Ethan M: I'll script the priming. Snippet to include in runbook: ```bash
python prime_top_keys.py --region eu-west --top 5000 --concurrency 10
python kv_check.py --region eu-west --window 300 --threshold 0.8
```
Sam K: For manifests, I'll include manifest timestamping and a UUID per write to detect duplicates. Also adding a short test that replays control-plane retries.
Nora V: Deadlines: routing PR by Tue EOD, snapshot idempotency test results Wed, priming script Fri, rehearsal next Tues. I'll create tracker ticket INFR-924 and add subtasks.
Ethan M: I'll open the terraform PR and include a canary pipeline. Tagging @Sam K for verification steps.
Sam K: Will review and attach test artifacts to INFR-924.
Nora V: Thanks. Quick ask: if anyone sees the DB-engineered retry pattern again, drop logs into the ticket and ping me. We'll close loop after rehearsal.
Ethan M: :thumbsup:
Sam K: :thumbsup:
Nora V: Closing thread unless any ETA slips — will repost summary to ENG-ONCALL.
